scripts.export: npm run export:pdf && npm run export:pptx
scripts.export:pdf: mkdir -p dist-export && slidev export --executable-path "$(command -v google-chrome)" --output dist-export/webmcp-biznaga-2026.pdf
scripts.export:pptx: mkdir -p dist-export && slidev export --format pptx --executable-path "$(command -v google-chrome)" --output dist-export/webmcp-biznaga-2026.pptx
scripts.export:png: mkdir -p dist-export && slidev export --format png --executable-path "$(command -v google-chrome)" --output dist-export/png
